::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
TSMC's original mainland China manufacturing site, predating the newer Nanjing 12-inch fab, serving legacy/mature-node demand. Exact current process node and wafer size were not independently confirmed in the sources checked for this tracker; recorded here for completeness rather than with the same confidence as the Nanjing entry.
:::

**Chinese name:** 台积电（上海）有限公司 (Táijīdiàn (Shànghǎi) Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

## What does this facility make?

Legacy/mature-node wafers — the precise node and wafer diameter are not confirmed in this tracker's current sources.

## Why does it matter?

Alongside Nanjing, establishes that TSMC's mainland China footprint is deliberately confined to mature/legacy process technology, not its leading-edge nodes.
